title: VPSF Claim Algebra Verifier
description: Verifies x402 VPSF Payment Claim composites (conjunction, implication, aggregation, selective disclosure, revocation) over the four canonical Payment Claim types (PaymentIntent, SettlementReceipt, RefundClaim, DelegationGrant), entirely client-side. Recomputes every JCS Preimage Hash via RFC 8785 canonicalisation and SHA-256, resolves component claims against a user-supplied manifest, and applies each operator's algebraic rules: vacuous-truth rejection for Implication, non-idempotent non-nestable Revocation, sorted-operand homogeneous-currency Aggregation with recomputed totals, and commitment recomputation for Selective Disclosure.

claims.description: Array of x402 Payment Claim objects, each carrying a claim_type (PaymentIntent, SettlementReceipt, RefundClaim, or DelegationGrant) plus the claim's own fields

composite.description: A VPSF composite: an operator node (conjunction/implication/aggregation/selective_disclosure/revocation) whose operands are claim objects, nested composites, or sha256: hash references resolved against the claims manifest

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_vpsf_claim_composite
mcp_tool_definition.description: Structurally verifies an x402 VPSF Claim Algebra composite (conjunction/implication/aggregation/selective_disclosure/revocation) and its component Payment Claims against draft-vauban-x402-vpsf-algebra-01. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Does not verify cryptographic evidence (STARK proofs, signatures) attached to component claims.

composite.description: VPSF operator composite over the claims
